description: A meteor addon, made by me.

releases.notes:
# v1.0.1 Changes (Since 1.0.0):
- Kill Effects now has lightning color, lightning sound settings
- Improved how Vertical Clip finds a teleportation point
- Added new .top (.up) command, that acts like Vertical Clip upwards.
- Added new .bottom (.down) command, that acts like Vertical Clip downwards.

## Discord
If you want to suggest a feature - you can contact me at https://discord.gg/MMbWUmjGKg

# Features in this version
- Vertical Clip (module) - Lets you vertically teleport through anything, by right clicking UP/DOWN side of a block. Should not deal fall damage.
- Always No Fall Packet (module) - Maybe (?) better then normal No Fall.
- Block Logger (module) (idea by matteipis) - Logs found selected blocks into a file, on chunk load.
- Kill Effects (module) (idea by Umnyasha) - Some effects when you kill entities.
- .svclip (command) Lets you vertically teleport through anything, by typing a command. Unlike normal .vclip this should also prevent fall damage.
- .ihclip (command) The same as .hclip, but lets you teleport more blocks at a time, by splitting the teleportation into multiple packets.
